# Explanation

Background reading: what the pieces are for and why they work the way they do.
None of it is needed to write a sequence, and all of it is worth having before
a verdict or a runtime figure surprises you.

For the authoring model itself (`pulserver.design`, scan loops), see
{doc}`the tutorial <tutorials/build_a_sequence_plugin>` and
{doc}`how_to` — this section is the machinery underneath a written sequence,
and what that machinery costs.
